newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-SEASON OVER FOR FIORENTINA'S RUI COSTA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SEASON OVER FOR FIORENTINA'S RUI COSTA.

text.p: Fiorentina's Portuguese international Rui Costa will miss the rest of the Italian league season due to injury, the club said on Tuesday.
The midfielder suffered a muscle strain in his left thigh against Perugia at the weekend and further tests showed that he would need up to two months to recover fully.
His injury was a further blow to Fiorentina who have already lost injured Swedish international midfielder Stefan Schwarz for the rest of the season which ends on June 1.
